items.title: General Dynamics (GD) Q3 Earnings Lift Guidance As Backlog Hits Record
items.summary: General Dynamics stock barely budged after its Q3 2026 report, ticking up about 0.5% to US$372.59. For a defense contractor posting double digit year on year revenue of US$14.57b and net earnings of US$1.23b, that is a muted response. Traders focused on the day’s small move. Long term holders are more likely watching something else entirely. The real story sits in the order book and cash engine.
